title: Vivid Clinic — normalized Google reviews dataset
description: Authoritative shape for data/google-reviews.json. Reviews are NEVER fabricated, rewritten, or exaggerated. Original text, reviewer name, rating, date, language and source are preserved exactly as returned by the authorized source (Google Business Profile API).

sourceComplete.description: true only when the full authorized review set was imported (GBP API). false for Places API or partial exports.

id.description: Stable source review id. Used for dedupe. Not rendered in the frontend.

reviewerName.description: Display name exactly as publicly shown. Never altered.

reviewerPhotoUrl.description: Reviewer's public Google profile photo (googleusercontent.com only, as shown beside the review on Google). Empty when unavailable; frontend falls back to an initials avatar.

originalText.description: Original review text, verbatim. May be empty for rating-only reviews.

translatedText.description: Optional. Google-provided translation, clearly labeled. Never replaces originalText.

originalLanguage.description: BCP-47-ish language code/name if known, else ''.

relativeDate.description: Human relative date computed at build time, e.g. '3 months ago'.

ownerReply.description: Owner's reply text if present, else ''.

isFeatured.description: Manual flag to surface a detailed/helpful review first. Never hides others.

tags.description: Derived theme tags (e.g. communication, staff). Only themes that actually appear in the text.
